description:
A tenant: who belongs to it, through which OIDC claim, and the limits its
vaults share. Cluster-scoped; its `metadata.name` is the tenant's slug,
used in API paths.

claimMappings.description:
The OIDC claim whose values grant the tenant roles. Absent or empty:
the tenant has no members.

claim.description: The token claim to read, such as `groups`: a string or a list of strings.

roles.description: The claim values granting each tenant role.

admin.description:
Values granting `admin`: create and delete vaults, manage bindings,
scoped tokens and notification rules.

member.description: Values granting `member`: the vaults a binding opens to them.

owner.description: Values granting `owner`: every right on the tenant and its vaults.

deletionPolicy.description:
What removing this document does: `Orphan` (default) disables the
tenant and keeps its data; `Delete` also deletes it after 30 days,
cancelled if the document comes back.

quota.description: Storage limits shared by the tenant's vaults. Absent fields: no limit.

maxFileSize.description:
The largest file a device may sync; larger ones stay local and are
reported.

storage.description:
Encrypted bytes the tenant may store, all vaults together. An upload
past it is refused.

retention.description:
How long history is kept, applied by the nightly maintenance pass.
Absent: every revision is kept, and deleted entries are purged after 90d.

deletedEntryTtl.description: A deleted entry stays restorable this long, then is purged. Absent: 90d.

maxRevisionAge.description: Revisions older than this are pruned, an entry's head never.

maxRevisionsPerEntry.description: At most this many revisions are kept per entry, the newest.

scopedTokens.description: What the tenant's scoped tokens may do beyond reading.

write.description:
Absent: false. Tokens of the tenant may carry `write` rules
(RFC 0004 §4.1); set back to false, their writes stop at once.

search.description: Full-text search over the tenant's notes.

enabled.description: Absent: false. The index is plaintext, so indexing is opt-in.

vaultNamespaces.description:
The namespaces allowed to declare a `KuraVault` for this tenant.
Absent: no namespace may.
